tool_input.content:
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Contact List']

# K1 holds TODAY() - use it as reference date
# J4 formula:
# If H4 within last 30 days AND I4='YES' -> HOLD
# If H4 more than 30 days ago AND I4='YES' -> TOUCH BASE
# Otherwise -> NO ACTION

formula = '=IF(AND(I4="YES",H4>=K1-30),"HOLD",IF(AND(I4="YES",H4<K1-30),"TOUCH BASE","NO ACTION"))'
ws['J4'] = formula

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
